row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (Request Pricing; single platform, no public tiers)
row.evidence: Anecdotes' pricing page is quote-only ("Request Pricing"), and its Okta SCIM guide says "This feature is only available with applicable packages."
row.notes: New row. Anecdotes (GRC platform, anecdotes.ai) sells one quote-only platform; the pricing page claims 'No feature gates', but the help centre's Okta SCIM guide says SCIM is only available with applicable packages and the SCIM-key API needs SCIM enabled for the tenant, so it is recorded as gated behind Contact Sales (see conflicts). SCIM 2.0-style endpoint https://gateway.anecdotes.ai/identity/v1/scim with a never-expiring provisioning token from Settings > SCIM; works with the Okta catalogue app (Create, Update, Deactivate) and a non-gallery Entra app; groups are not supported; unassigning deactivates the user. Roles go through the SCIM roles attribute (built-in values or custom role IDs). SAML SSO with any SAML 2.0 IdP is configured separately. A REST Identity API (api.anecdotes.ai) can list, create/invite, update and delete users and manage roles; an Audit Logs API exists. Plan for the API is not stated.

plans.name: Anecdotes platform
plans.notes: Single quote-only platform. SCIM docs say 'only available with applicable packages'; package names are not public.

auth.token_source: Settings > SCIM > Generate (provisioning token and URL)

operations.notes: Okta app supports Create Users, Update User Attributes and Deactivate Users. PUT vs PATCH not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: User stays in deactivated status on the Anecdotes platform.

custom.how: email_login_disabled (boolean) in the core User namespace, added as a custom attribute in Okta or Entra

attributes.notes: Entra guide says to keep only these attributes. Okta guide: updating email and title is not available.

roles.how: roles attribute with built-in values (anecdotes:admin, anecdotes:manager, anecdotes:it, anecdotes:auditor, stakeholder_role, contributor_role, viewer_role, anecdotes:trustcenter_access_manager) or a custom role ID; Entra maps app roles via SingleAppRoleAssignment

limitations.text: Updating user email and title via SCIM is not available.
SCIM is only available with applicable packages and must be enabled for the tenant.

auth.notes: API token (Administration > API tokens, with expiry and role) is exchanged for a 60-minute JWT.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No gallery app: Anecdotes' guide uses a non-gallery app against the generic SCIM endpoint (learn.microsoft.com anecdotes tutorial URLs return 404).

onelogin.notes: OneLogin connector page not loaded (bot challenge); Anecdotes' OneLogin guide adds the Anecdotes catalogue app for SAML only.

jumpcloud.notes: Anecdotes' JumpCloud guide uses a Custom Application for SAML; no provisioning guide.
